examples.text: The women, stout, strong, brazen-faced creatures, in most cases looked able to thrash any of the partners with whom they consorted.

examples.text: And now the Trumpets terribly from far, / With rattling Clangor, rouze the sleepy War. / The Souldiers Shouts succeed the Brazen Sounds, / And Heav'n, from Pole to Pole, the Noise rebounds.

glosses: Shameless or impudent; shocking or audacious; brash.

examples.text: She was brazen enough to deny stealing the handbag even though she was caught on camera doing so.

But the smile in his eyes, the touch of his finger moving slowly and feather-light from chin to throat and along the sensitive skin of her neck made it impossible to concentrate on rebuke.
